exposure: All rosters have prior project exposure. This is broader prospective-scope evidence, not untouched confirmation.
future_contrast: BGE minus aligned original compact RoBERTa on four named endpoints. Existing neural broader inference and independent assembly must finish before paired contrasts. Never substitute older checkpoints or infer a difference from nonmatching population means.
limits: BGE-only scores may be published as absolute descriptive results. No superiority interval until paired comparator outputs are complete. Existing broader RAG family and running scripts unchanged.
model: Reuse exact original compact BGE coefficients, label order and TRAIN-selected cutoffs; no selection from these wider results.

scoring_contract.labels: Freeze labels from full-roster support, never from a bootstrap sample or valid-only subset. Missing annotations are excluded, observed empty lists retained. Gold-hate gate for fine heads, legal independent.
scoring_contract.limits: Exposed data, fixed models/pools/repeats, conditional resampling intervals. No untouched-test, universal-winning-system or causal-mechanism claim.
scoring_contract.paired_mask: Intersection of valid predictions across every compared fixed condition/repeat; own-valid scores and full-roster failure bounds accompany contrasts.
scoring_contract.replicates: Three fixed decoder repeats; three fitted encoder seeds; selection/permutation variants separate from decoder repeats. Difference of means of individual F1 scores, never pool their predictions as extra observations.
scoring_contract.resampling: 10000 paired draws of whole normalized-text clusters; HateCheck uses connected template/reference/text components. Same cluster weights for every compared setting.
scoring_contract.sensitivity: Natural data source-stratified cluster draws. A cluster spanning sources uses the sorted tuple of its source memberships as a stratum, so a cluster is never split. HateCheck also gets item-level sensitivity. German TEST additionally reports exclusion of its prospectively flagged whitespace-only text.

sensitivity: Also score exclusion of every exact-normalized original English core text, retaining full-roster macro labels. Source and label metrics are descriptive; HateCheck uses functional groups/template clusters in subsequent paired comparisons.
